description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for handling npm package resolutions, archive source paths, and temporary directories, specific to the openclaw project.

methods.name: buildNpmResolutionFields
methods.description: Constructs a NpmResolutionFields object from an optional NpmSpecResolution.

methods.name: withTempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory, executes a callback with its path, and cleans up afterward.

methods.name: resolveArchiveSourcePath
methods.description: Resolves the path of an archive source, verifying its existence and type.

methods.name: packNpmSpecToArchive
methods.description: Packs an npm specification into an archive, returning its path and metadata.
